instruction:
Single Storey School Wing IFC And Revit Room Schedule CSV

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a single-storey school wing, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a Revit room area schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 7 IfcSpace entities, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 4 IfcDoor entities, and 4 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token classroom at least 3 times, art at least once, admin at least once, toilet at least once, and corridor at least once.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers room name,area in that order and exactly 7 non-empty data rows.
8. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains these exact room name and area rows: Administration Room=17.50, Art Room=30.00, Classroom 1=66.50, Classroom 2=66.50, Classroom 3=66.50, Corridor=65.00, and Toilet Room=10.00.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
